title: Linear vs. Non-Linear Plot
skills: distinguish linear from non-linear plot structures
analyze how plot structure affects pacing and reader understanding
evaluate how authors use structure to reveal information and create suspense
alignment_note: Compares linear and non-linear plot structures and explains how narrative events may be arranged chronologically or presented through techniques such as flashbacks and shifts in time. Supports structural analysis, sequencing, pacing, suspense, and interpretation of authorial choices across high school English courses.
